rulings.Case Title: THE ESTATE OF KEVIN CHARLES HARTZOG
rulings.Calendar Matter: PETITION FOR PROBATE OF WILL AND FOR LETTERS TESTAMENTARY
rulings.Rulings: Continued to 09/01/2026. Issues necessitating continuance: 1) The petition requests that bond be waived because the will waives bond. It also lists decedent's unborn child, Jade Kevin Chen-Hartzog, as an omitted child in Item 8 of the petition. If a decedent fails to provide in a testamentary instrument for a child of decedent born after the execution of all of the decedent's testamentary instruments, the omitted child shall receive a share in the decedent's estate equal in value to that which the child would have received if the decedent had died without having executed any testamentary instrument (Probate Code Section 21620). In a supplemental declaration verified petition, please clarify how bond can be waived. 2) All notices must include language about remote appearances (LRSF 14.1.C.6). Please address the above issues and deliver courtesy copies of all further filings to this examiner no later than 08/25/2026 to avoid additional continuance.
